title: Munkholmen buoy echosounder (EK80 MVBS), ADCP and CTD dataset, Trondheim Fjord, April 2026
description: Mean volume backscattering strength (MVBS) at 38 and 200 kHz from a Simrad EK80 WBT Mini deployed for 3.5 days (2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14) on the SINTEF OceanLab Munkholmen buoy in Trondheim Fjord, Norway, with ADCP currents and echosounder backscatter (Nortek Signature100) and near-surface CTD data (Sea-Bird SBE19plus) from the same period. See README.md in the deposit for contents, processing and known limitations.

locations.place: SINTEF OceanLab Munkholmen buoy, Trondheim Fjord, Norway

notes: Funded by Akershus fylkeskommune (AFK), project 'Digital Solutions for Automated Monitoring of Seaweed Farm Operations'. R&D partner: SINTEF Ocean. EK80 WBT Mini loaned by NTNU.
